recommended_approach: Use Mantaflow’s fluid simulation by configuring a gas Domain via `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` and at least one Flow via `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings`, then bake the simulation using the fluid bake operators (queried in docs as `bpy.ops.fluid.bake`, `bpy.ops.fluid.bake_data`, `bpy.ops.fluid.bake_noise`).

FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength: Attribute available on the domain for controlling noise influence/detail: `noise_strength`.
FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim: Attribute available on the domain for animating noise over time: `noise_time_anim`.
FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio: Attribute available on the domain affecting FLIP behavior: `flip_ratio`.

FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture: Attribute available on the flow for supplying a noise texture: `noise_texture`.
